preconditions.description: The number of cities n must be between 2 and 100,000.
The number of roads m must be between 1 and 100,000.
The capital city s must be a valid city number between 1 and n.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= n and 1 <= ui <= n and vi != ui and 1 <= wi <= 1000 for vi, ui, wi in roads)
preconditions.description: Each road must connect two different cities with valid lengths.
The distance l must be between 0 and 1,000,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of missile silos located at distance l from the capital.
